rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for strong enthusiasm or passionate interest, especially in “curb your enthusiasm.”

example.english: They are full of enthusiasm for this project.
example.traditional: 佢對呢個計劃充滿熱情。
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 cung1 mun5 jit6 cing4

rows.note: Use this for practical drive or eagerness to put effort into doing something, rather than emotional passion.

example.english: Everyone is working with great enthusiasm.
example.jyutping: daai6 gaa1 zou6 je5 dou1 hou2 jau5 gon3 ging6

rows.note: Use this for a subject or activity someone is keenly interested in, such as a hobby or personal interest.

example.english: I have always had a lot of enthusiasm for photography.
example.traditional: 我對攝影一直都好有興趣。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 sip3 jing2 jat1 zik6 dou1 hou2 jau5 hing3 ceoi3
